SELECT p.id, COALESCE(SUM(touch.weight * POW(2.0, -touch.age_days / 30.0)), 0.0) AS raw_weight, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN touch.age_days <= 21.0 THEN touch.weight ELSE 0.0 END), 0.0) AS recent_weight, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN touch.age_days > 21.0 AND touch.age_days <= 120.0 THEN touch.weight ELSE 0.0 END), 0.0) AS prior_weight, DATE_FORMAT(MAX(touch.touched_at), '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS last_touch_at, SUM(CASE WHEN touch.age_days <= 21.0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS recent_touch_count FROM person p LEFT JOIN ( SELECT source.entity_id, source.touched_at, source.weight, GREATEST(0.0, TIMESTAMPDIFF(MICROSECOND, source.touched_at, #{reference}) / 86400000000.0) AS age_days FROM ( SELECT a.person_id AS entity_id, a.timestamp AS touched_at, CASE LOWER(a.type) WHEN 'meeting' THEN 1.0 WHEN 'call' THEN 0.8 WHEN 'email' THEN 0.6 ELSE 0.5 END AS weight FROM activity a WHERE a.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND a.person_id IS NOT NULL UNION ALL SELECT n.person_id AS entity_id, n.created_at AS touched_at, 0.4 AS weight FROM note n WHERE n.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND n.visibility = 'workspace' AND n.person_id IS NOT NULL UNION ALL SELECT t.person_id AS entity_id, t.created_at AS touched_at, 0.3 AS weight FROM task t WHERE t.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND t.person_id IS NOT NULL ) source WHERE source.touched_at IS NOT NULL AND source.touched_at <= #{reference} ) touch ON touch.entity_id = p.id WHERE AND p.suspended_at IS NULL GROUP BY p.id ORDER BY p.id
